label: Craftsmanship Academy
description: Course and lesson recordings. Inherits the RoleModel base and swaps in the unit signature colour via the wallpaper.

rationale.webcamMaskShape: Circle over rounded — a teaching video wants the instructor to feel present, and a circular crop reads warmer than a rectangle.
rationale.webcamSizePreset: Larger than the RoleModel default. In a lesson the person matters as much as the screen.
rationale.autoFocusAll: Course content is dense; auto-focus on every region keeps the eye where the typing is.

units.$comment: Curriculum wayfinding from DESIGN.md. Pick the unit and the wallpaper follows.

javascript.$comment: Signature colour is still TBD in DESIGN.md — deep purple or teal. Falls back to the RoleModel board until someone decides.
